newsitem.title: USA: CBOT and Taiwan set timetable for futures exchange.
newsitem.headline: CBOT and Taiwan set timetable for futures exchange.

text.p: The Chicago Board of Trade said Monday it had set up a timetable with Taiwan officials for the creation of a futures exchange and clearinghouse in Taiwan.

The timetable included the start a training program, the passage of necessary legislation in Taiwan, the transformation of Taiwan's Futures Market Promotion Committee into a project implementation unit, and product development, the CBOT said.
The CBOT and Taiwan officials formed a joint venture last May to develop a derivatives exchange in Taipei.
Monday's agreement was reached after a meeting in Chicago between the CBOT and the Futures Market Promotion Committee.

The Taiwan delegation included Lu Daung-yen, chairman of the Taiwan Securities Exchange Commission, Lin Shau-dai, president of the Taiwan Stock Exchange, and the chairmen of the Taiwan Securities Dealers Associations.
